2608.13120.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
2608.13120.paper_summary: Agent Skills are today either hand-authored or produced in a single LLM generation pass, and consequently possess no closed loop through which they might improve from the interaction failures they actually cause. Recent work does close this loop, but derives its feedback from single-turn question-answering evaluation. The consequence is a sharp asymmetry: once the first round has patched the gaps that a single exchange can reveal, the evolution gradient decays, the defects that surface only across multiple turns remain invisible, and evolution stalls. Governance in these systems is likewise driven by an end-to-end verification score, a scalar gate that can reject a degraded candidate but can neither localize nor repair its structural cause. We argue that the binding constraint on sustained skill evolution is neither editing capability nor the number of iterations, but whether the evaluation feedback keeps supplying trustworthy evolution gradients. We introduce SkillEvo, in which trustworthy feedback generates the gradient and controllable governance constrains its direction. The first component recasts multi-turn user simulation from an evaluation endpoint into a feedback generator: follow-up questions expose defects layer by layer, so that every round of revision both consumes feedback and produces new feedback. The second replaces the passive rejection of a scalar gate with an independent governance layer that actively repairs factual degradation and structural bloat, preventing the gradient from drifting as degradation accumulates. Across six categories of cloud services, 9 production Skills, and 98 skill-reference files, SkillEvo surpasses self-reflection-based evolution by 23.0 points and single- turn-QA-driven evolution by 15.4 points.
2608.13120.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能今天要麼是手動編寫的，要麼是在單次 LLM 生成過程中產生的，因此沒有閉環可以從實際造成的互動失敗中改進。最近的工作確實關閉了這個循環，但其反饋來自單輪問答評估。結果是一種明顯的不對稱：一旦第一輪修補了單次交換所揭示的缺口，演化梯度便會衰減，僅在多輪中出現的缺陷則保持隱形，演化停滯。在這些系統中，治理同樣由端到端的驗證分數驅動，這是一個可以拒絕降級候選者的標量閘，但無法定位或修復其結構原因。我們認為持續技能演化的約束條件既不是編輯能力，也不是迭代次數，而是評估反饋是否持續提供可靠的演化梯度。我們引入了 SkillEvo，在其中可靠的反饋生成梯度，而可控的治理約束其方向。第一個組件將多輪用戶模擬從評估端點重新構建為反饋生成器：後續問題逐層揭示缺陷，使得每一輪修訂既消耗反饋又產生新的反饋。第二個組件用一個獨立的治理層替代了標量閘的被動拒絕，該層主動修復事實退化和結構膨脹，防止隨著退化的累積而使梯度漂移。在六類雲服務、9 個生產技能和 98 個技能參考文件中，SkillEvo 超越了基於自我反思的演化 23.0 分，並超越了基於單輪問答驅動的演化 15.4 分。
